title: 1 Chess Speedrunner vs 3 Hunters
summary: Multiplayer 'manhunt': the creator (purple king) races across a long vertical map of several stacked boards while three friends (Red Panda, ViperKing, Franchise - each with their own king on successive boards) hunt him. Hunters capture his king to win; he wins by capturing the dragon egg at the far end. Regular and fairy pieces (nightrider, dabbaba(-rider), camel(-rider), cannon, grasshopper, Amazon, alfil, ferz, brick obstacles, nuke, bazooka, duck, a 'dog') lie on the map and can be collected into a hotbar and dropped later. Speedrunner has a 1:3 move disadvantage (each hunter moves in turn) and 5-minute clock (no increment). Game 1: Viper tries to move the nuke, which detonates and eliminates Red Panda's king; the speedrunner lost a game on time ('I've lost'), then wins a game by a nightrider jump capturing the dragon egg with seconds left. The duck only quacks and cannot move.
rules: 4 players: 1 speedrunner (purple king, start of map) vs 3 hunters (red, etc. kings placed along the map).
Turn order: speedrunner, then each of the 3 hunters (1 move vs 3 moves).
Hunters win by capturing the speedrunner's king; speedrunner wins by capturing the dragon egg at the far end (also can eliminate hunter kings).
Pieces lying on the map can be collected into a player's hotbar; placing (dropping) a hotbar piece on the board uses a turn.
Map: long column of stacked boards with brick obstacles (impassable/capturable bricks).

Fairy pieces as standard fairy movement: nightrider (repeated knight leaps), dabbaba (2-square orthogonal jump), dabbaba-rider, camel (3,1 leaper), camel-rider, cannon (moves like rook, captures by jumping a screen at any distance), grasshopper (moves along queen lines hopping over a piece landing just beyond), Amazon (Q+N), alfil, ferz.
Nuke: attempting to move it detonates it, destroying pieces around it (it eliminated Red Panda's king).
Duck: clicking it only quacks; cannot move, blocks nothing.
Chess clock 5 minutes each, no increment.
win_condition: Speedrunner: capture the dragon egg. Hunters: capture the speedrunner's king.
